posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed in Linear's integration directory (DR 85). You get a dedicated page and dofollow links to your website.

Massive shout-out to @aarondelasy for sharing it with me

Here is how:

1. Build a Linear integration with OAuth that does something simple, like creating Linear issues from your SaaS (ask Claude to do it for you).
2. Publish a docs page on your site that explains how to connect it. That's the install link Linear asks for.
3. Make an icon and 1 to 3 showcase images from Linear's Figma template.
4. Fill in the submission form from Linear's integration directory guide and send the assets to integrations@linear.app.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 Linear integration directory 构建 OAuth 集成（如创建 Linear issues），发布文档页、图标和展示图后提交，得到 DR85 dofollow 外链页面。

posts.content:
Another free backlink hack for your SaaS: get listed on HubSpot Marketplace (DR 93). You get a dedicated page linking to your site.

Here is how:
1. Build a public OAuth app
2. Get 3 active installs
3. Submit a listing

Note: manual review.

https://t.co/bOtxDGZhjg
posts.author: Rapid Indexer
posts.notes: 在 HubSpot Marketplace 构建 public OAuth app，获取 3 个 active installs 后提交 listing，得到 DR93 外链页面（manual review）。

posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on Cloudflare's new CMS, EmDash (DR 76). You get a dedicated page in its plugin directory and a dofollow link

Massive shout-out to @apexmarketinguk for sharing it with me

Here is how:

1. Build a small EmDash plugin that connects to your SaaS (ask Claude to do it for you).
2. Put your website in author.url in the manifest. That's your dofollow link.
3. Log in with Bluesky and run emdash-plugin publish.

A few notes:

Use your domain as your Bluesky handle, so your listing reads @ yourdomain .com.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 Cloudflare EmDash 插件目录构建小插件连接 SaaS，在 manifest 的 author.url 放网站，用 Bluesky 登录发布，得到 DR76 dofollow 外链。
